title: Z-Image-Turbo joins image generation
summary:
Z-Image-Turbo arrived, generated images shed their logo, and the old auth site got a dated closing notice.

Added the self-hosted `zimage` model with 2× upscaling, plus routing to a dedicated server pool. A follow-up corrected how requested dimensions are calculated before upscaling.

Image generation was changed to leave off the Pollinations logo. The `nologo` parameter was removed because there is no longer a logo to opt out of; JPEG conversion and EXIF metadata remain.

A notice on auth.pollinations.ai names December 15, 2025 at 00:00 UTC as its closing time and points users to Enter. It warns that existing tokens will stop working and data will not be migrated.

daily.text: Generate images with `zimage`, a self-hosted Z-Image-Turbo model that applies 2× upscaling. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=zimage).
